description: Public-data native 1.0.0 LC0-value probe: train from v4 on LC0 positions labeled by LC0 root_q converted to centipawns. This tests already-labeled ODbL public data without Stockfish relabeling.

validation.promotion_gate: Compare against current native v4 first. Only run Berserk if this is positive against v4.
validation.ownership_definition: No external net weights. Training positions and labels are LC0 ODbL public training data converted through root_q; initialization is clean Enyo-native v4.
validation.reason: LC0 positions with Stockfish-d12 scalar labels lost to v4 at 100%, 10%, and 1% doses. This tests LC0 as already-labeled public data instead of relabeling it with Stockfish.
